messages.body:
**10. Every 2 s: is it paid? Answered by the provider only**

For a charging order each pass asks the provider for the charge (`Payments.Get`, worker/worker.go:121) and reads the webhook log the shop keeps. The browser coming back from the bank proves nothing: the status is asked of the provider (:120). Two extra gates: the stock must still be reserved (:133-135), and a passed deadline releases the stock and fails the order (:116-119).
